name: Atlantis (STS-43)
about: Atlantis (STS-43) (1991-054A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1991 Aug  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1991 Aug  4), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
